name: Ministry of Health

scam_info.sample: Government officials will never ask you to transfer money over a phone call. If you're unsure if something is a scam, call ScamShield (opens in new tab) at 1799.
scam_info.notes: Generic whole-of-government banner only. MOH sitemap (11,326 URLs; lastmod bulk-set 2026-07-30) has NO scam/phishing/impersonation advisory page; 'fraud' hits are healthcare-fraud enforcement/PQ replies (e.g. /newsroom/clinics-taken-to-task-for-fraudulent-claims/). Low value; included so the pipeline knows MOH publishes nothing scam-specific.

notes: official_domains moh.gov.sg (b; SGDI). Unverified (search snippet of SPF 20230905 advisory on fake HealthHub app SMS): legitimate MOH messages used sender ID 'MOH' (pre-July-2024; now gov.sg) and were not sent from mobile numbers. Healthcare impersonation scams (SingHealth/polyclinic, HealthHub) are published by SPF/ScamShield and the clusters, not MOH. Communicable Diseases Agency (cda.gov.sg) is a new 2026 MOH statboard per SGDI.
